subject: Fixed-issue validation: screenshots, config exports, and compensating controls
messages:
From: Alan Park <alan.park@finexco.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: security@finexco.com
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 15:24:00 -0700
Subject: Request: remediation evidence for pen test findings (FinexCo engagement)

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the quick turnaround on the items from last week's engagement. FinexCo completed its internal review of the penetration report and we have three remaining findings we'd like evidence for before we can mark the items closed on our side: FIND-23 (open redirect), FIND-47 (improper input sanitization on analytics endpoint), and FIND-89 (exposed privileged API).

For closure we need:
- Screenshots showing the fix in the UI where applicable (e.g., error + success screens)
- Config exports or snippets for relevant services (nginx, API gateway, IAM policy excerpts)
- Persistent ticket(s) with remediation notes (link to Jira or ticket number)
- Explanation of any compensating controls if a full code fix is staged (WAF rules, rate limits, additional logging/alerts)

Can you provide a consolidated evidence package (screenshots + config snippets + ticket links) and a short note describing the compensating controls you implemented? Ideally by EOD Tuesday 30 Mar. If some items are still work-in-progress, an interim package with dates for full verification will suffice.

Thanks,
Alan
Alan Park
Security Engineering
FinexCo

---
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Alan Park <alan.park@finexco.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: remediation evidence for pen test findings (FinexCo engagement)

Hi Alan — thanks for the clear list. We can assemble the package and provide an interim set of artifacts this evening, final verification by close of business Wednesday. Quick summary of what you'll receive in the interim package:

- Screenshots: UI error-to-success flow for FIND-23 and a successful validation screenshot for FIND-47. (Attached: 20270329_fix-screenshot-1.png)
- Config exports: nginx vhost that contains the input validation routing and the gateway rule snippet for FIND-89 (attached stub: nginx-vhost-export-20270329.conf)
- Tickets: we'll provide Jira IDs (see follow-up from Karthik) and short remediation notes for each finding.
- Compensating controls implemented: WAF rule id RED-WAF-2027-07, temporary rate limit on analytics endpoint (30req/min per IP), and increased logging/alerting to surface anomalous privilege-access attempts.

If you'd like us to run a quick verification scan on your staging instance, please share a staging URL or a short window; otherwise we'll run our internal integration checks and provide signed screenshots and logs. We're also happy to redact any customer-identifying strings from logs.

Attachments in this interim email are lightweight stubs for review; we'll push full exports into a shared Drive folder and include links.

Best,
Priyom Das
Senior Security Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alan Park <alan.park@finexco.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: remediation evidence for pen test findings (FinexCo engagement)

Alan / Priyom — following up with ticket references and artifact locations. Quick status: all three findings have targeted remediation work completed in our staging environment; two are pushed to production (FIND-23, FIND-89) and FIND-47 is scheduled for final regression tomorrow morning. Details below: 

- FIND-23 (open redirect) — remediation: strict whitelist for redirect targets and canonicalization; verification screenshot attached. Jira: RED-1123 (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-1123).
- FIND-47 (input sanitization) — remediation: server-side input sanitizer added and schema validation for analytics payloads; Jira: RED-1124 (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-1124). Patch pushed to staging; production rollout pending post-regression.
- FIND-89 (privileged API exposure) — remediation: auth guard + permission check added; temporary API gateway rule to limit access to service-to-service only. Jira: RED-1125 (internal, will provide link on request).

Artifacts provided in shared Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExampleShareLink (contains screenshots, config snippets, and full nginx export). Attached to this thread are lightweight stubs to confirm receipt: nginx-vhost-export-20270329.conf, interim-mitigation-checklist-20270329.pdf.

Compensating controls implemented (summary):
- WAF rule RED-WAF-2027-07 (blocks open redirect vectors)
- Rate limiting rule applied to /api/analytics (30req/min/IP)
- Alerting on privilege escalation attempts (CloudWatch + PagerDuty integration)
- Short-term increase of auth token rotation to 4 hours for affected service account keys

Let us know if you need the KMS audit trail for the token rotation — we can export an HSM-backed audit snippet. We'll also provide a short verification test report once FIND-47 completes regression tomorrow.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Staff Engineer, Platform Security
Redwood Inference

> On Mon, Mar 29, 2027 at 16:03, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com> wrote:

From: Alan Park <alan.park@finexco.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: security@finexco.com
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: remediation evidence for pen test findings (FinexCo engagement)

Thanks, team — this looks comprehensive and useful. Two quick asks before we mark the findings closed on our side: 

1) Can you provide a short verification artifact for FIND-47 (post-regression) showing a sample request, the pre-fix vulnerable response (from pen test log), and the post-fix response? A single PDF or a short screencast is fine.
2) For FIND-89, please include the API gateway rule (or a sanitized snippet) and the proof that the privileged API is not reachable from the public internet (curl response / 403) from an external probe.

If you can drop those two items into the Drive folder and paste the final links here by EOD today, we should be able to close the three items. Appreciate the quick remediation and the compensating controls detail — that helped a lot.

Best,
Alan
Security Engineering
FinexCo
